clarification_questions: How is 'wait time' defined in your context? Please specify which timestamps represent:
Which OVST columns represent which events?
- Is vsttime the time patient first arrived, or time of examination?
- Does overtime flag indicate after-hours visit type only?
Do you have access to registration logs or appointment system?
- OVST.nexttime (from previous appointment) vs current vsttime could estimate wait
- But this only works if vsttime > nexttime (actual visit vs scheduled)
Would you accept an alternative metric?
- Time from appointment to visit completion?
- Average visits per time slot (queue depth)?
- Distribution of visit times by clinic?
